note: Where no figure may stand and which poses are never staged (constitution II: never shown, never voiced). Read by scene/courtyard.js, scene/courtyard.test.js and the routine staging tests. Boxes are [x0, x1, z0, z1] in metres in the layout frame, with a 1 m margin round the footprints in layout.json.

zones.why: geo-slaughter-pillars-zone, geo-slaughter-tables-zone and geo-slaughter-rings-zone (north of the altar): the place of the slaughter is never staged or dressed
geo-kodesh-hakodashim: the inside of the Holy of Holies is never entered or shown
